steps.subject: Welcome to OrganicAI - Your Marketing Autopilot is Ready
steps.headline: Your Marketing Autopilot is Ready
steps.body: Thanks for joining OrganicAI! Set up your first workspace, connect your social accounts, and let our AI start generating and publishing content for you automatically.

steps.subject: Quick tip: How to get the most from your Brand Context Engine
steps.headline: Maximize Your Brand Context
steps.body: Our AI analyzes your website and business description to build a Brand Context Profile. The more detail you provide during onboarding, the better your auto-generated posts will match your voice and audience.

steps.subject: Your first week with OrganicAI - Here's what happened
steps.headline: Your First Week in Review
steps.body: You've been on OrganicAI for a few days now. Check your dashboard to see how many posts were auto-generated, which platforms they were published to, and how your content pipeline is performing.

steps.subject: Your marketing autopilot is waiting for you
steps.headline: We Noticed You've Been Away
steps.body: Your OrganicAI workspace is still set up and ready to go. Connect your social accounts or add a new campaign to get your automated posting back on track.
